description: This file contains functions related to building and rendering tree menus for test specification, test execution, and requirements in the TestLink project. It includes functions for generating test specification trees, preparing nodes for tree display, rendering nodes for visual representation, and filtering test cases based on various criteria such as status, custom fields, and test plan associations.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for constructing tree menu structures and configuration objects.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing test project management, including methods for retrieving tree managers, node types, and test case prefixes. Used in building test specification and requirement trees.

methods.name: generateTestSpecTree
methods.description: Generates a data structure representing the test specification tree for a given project, applying filters and options.

methods.name: prepareNode
methods.description: Prepares a node for display in the test specification tree, calculating test case counts and filtering nodes based on criteria.

methods.name: renderTreeNode
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a tree node for visual display, including handling test case links, icons, and counters.

methods.name: filter_by_cf_values
methods.description: Recursively filters test case nodes based on custom field values.

methods.name: buildKeywordsFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter object for test case keywords based on selected keyword IDs.

methods.name: buildExecTypeFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter object for test case execution types.

methods.name: buildImportanceFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter object for test case importance levels.

methods.name: generate_reqspec_tree
methods.description: Builds a requirement specification tree structure for display, applying filtering options.

methods.name: get_filtered_req_map
methods.description: Fetches a map of requirements matching specified filter criteria, used in building requirement trees.

methods.name: prepare_reqspeccoverage_treenode
methods.description: Prepares a requirement tree node for display, calculating counts and applying filters.

methods.name: generateTestReqCoverageTree
methods.description: Creates a requirement coverage tree structure with filtering options for visualization.

methods.name: prepare_reqspeccoverage_treenode
methods.description: Prepares a requirement coverage tree node for display, calculating counts and applying filters.
